 About The Team
 Embedded Engineering Capability: Empowering Innovation in the World of Embedded Software.
Join Accenture to shape a future looking Software-Defined Vehicle Platform that unifies Linux, Android, QNX, AUTOSAR & Adaptive AUTOSAR into one powerful developer ecosystem, sustaining innovation in ADAS and Infotainment , building safe, secure, and continuously upgradable vehicles
 How You Will Make An Impact
 The Senior Embedded C++ Low Level Engineer is responsible for:
 Design and implement complex low-level drivers in modern C++ (version 11+), including tests and documentation.
 Integrate existing drivers from suppliers
 Review and approve requirements, architecture, design, code, test and documentation.
 What you need to succeed :
Must Have:
Advanced knowledge of modern C++ for embedded firmware and drivers (15+ years of experience)
 Knowledge of low-level buses (I2C, SPI, MDIO, CAN, LIN, Ethernet).
 Understanding of RTOS and embedded OS concepts.
 Experience in multi-core development.
 Experience with gtest and gmock for C++ unit tests
Nice to Have:
 Tricore, ARM and POSIX knowledge
 AUTOSAR knowledge
 Experience with MISRA, CERT and other static code analysis standards
 Experience with Python and PyTest
 Knowledge of safety and security standards.
